high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "ttl.india." The post features a photograph of Malana village, which is situated on a lush green hillside with a backdrop of mountains. The village appears to be nestled among dense forests, with houses and buildings built into the slopes, showcasing a harmonious blend of human habitation and nature. The text overlay on the image provides information about Malana village, describing it as one of the oldest democracies in the world.
